title: Serro
extract:

Acquisition
The Serro's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Notes
When combining elements, the innate  Electricity damage is added last.
The Serro has a chance to inflict  Blast status effect on its jump attacks.
The Serro is one of the few Clan Tech weapons that doesn't require Forma to craft, along with the  Nami Skyla,  Amprex,  Anku, and  Tonbo.
With maxed rank dual-stat mods  Virulent Scourge,  Voltaic Strike,  Volcanic Edge, and  Vicious Frost the Serro can achieve a status chance of 85%.  Drifting Contact and  Melee Prowess increases this further to 98.75%.

Trivia
The three blades on the weapon fold up when not in use and move when idle, making it one of the few melee weapons with a non-static model.
The weapon itself retracts when not in use.
This is the 5th melee weapon released to natively deal  Electricity damage, and the third polearm weapon to be released after the  Orthos and  Orthos Prime.
The weapon's name is derived from the Latin word serro, which means "I cut" and is the origin of the word serrate.
The Serro was first seen as an accidentally leaked Codex entry in Update 13, along with the  Venka and the Bo Prime, before any of the weapons were released.
The Serro is the first single-headed polearm to be released.
The weapon description is the first - and last source of information on the "Rebels in the Sedna region", making it the only mention of their existence in the lore.
